summary: Village Farms International filed Form 8-K to disclose a registered direct offering of 7,500,000 common shares at $2.00 per share, raising ~$15M gross via A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. Proceeds are for general working capital. There are no special-situation elements: it is a routine at-the-market/common-stock takedown off an existing shelf (Form S-3). The offering is expected to close June 8, 2026. No change of control, activist involvement, strategic review, or restructuring. The filing simply reports entry into securities purchase agreements and a placement agent agreement with customary terms.
